# Play — Watchtowers

- SudokuPad: [Watchtowers on SudokuPad](https://sudokupad.)
- f-puzzles: [Watchtowers on f-puzzles](https://www.f-puzzles.com/?)

Both links carry the same f-puzzles JSON (lz-string compressed), including the solution, so SudokuPad can check your answer.
The skyscraper clues are native f-puzzles clues. The lookout rule is invented and has no f-puzzles entry. Each tower is a
**cosmetic** amber circle in its cell, so the apps won't enforce the rule. That's no problem for solving, because the answer check
compares against the solution. I have not opened the links in a browser. If anything looks different, use `grid.svg` in this
folder as the reference picture.

Towers (8): r1c7, r2c9, r4c2, r5c1, r7c6, r9c1, r9c3, r9c7.
Skyscrapers (5): left of row 2: 5; left of row 3: 3; below column 1: 4; below column 3: 7; below column 5: 5.

Fallback: `puzzle.json` in this folder is the machine-readable source (constraints, solution).
